aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Mahāgaurī, the māyā of the world;
victory to you, Umā, Bhavānī; victory to you, Mahāmāyā.
aarti.pad2: You are Candrakalī and Ambā full of tenderness;
victory to you, Śakti; victory, victory to you, Mother Jagadambā.
You are Bhīmā Devī, Mother Vimalā,
and Kauśikī Devī, famed in the world.
aarti.pad3: In the home of Himācala your form is Gaurī;
Mahākālī and Durgā are your forms.
Satī burned in the sacrificial fire-pit;
that very smoke made the form of Kālī.
aarti.pad4: Dharma became the lion that came as your mount;
It was then that the Mother received the name Mahāgaurī,
and she removed the trouble of whoever came to her for refuge.
aarti.pad5: Mother, has his spoilt work set right.
Speak, devotees: what are you thinking of?
Mother Mahāgaurī, victory to you for ever.
